summary: First test iteration for StudyAdda Dhanbad. Backend: 21/21 pytest tests pass (catalog, auth, test sessions with negative-marking scoring, bookmarks CRUD, admin CRUD + bulk CSV, student 403 on admin, guest start). Frontend mobile UI (390x844): login + Continue as Guest, EN/HI language toggle, Practice tab -> exam IBPS-PO -> chapter mode -> quant -> percentage -> start -> quiz (options, mark, palette, next, submit + confirm) -> result screen with score & chapter stats -> review with solutions. Admin flow via localStorage token: mixed practice (4 chapters) submitted, History tab lists it, Profile -> Admin Dashboard (stats 2 users / 35 Q / 1 verified / 2 tests, question list, delete buttons) -> Add Question form renders all fields. Bookmarks screen renders empty state. Negative marking 0.25 confirmed (-0.75 for 3 wrong, -1.5 for 6 wrong in mixed test).

ui_bugs.issue: Error toast 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' appears on screen load. Indicates a stray text/whitespace child inside a View. Investigate the chip-row ScrollView blocks and conditional <>...</> fragments (lines 75-86, 91-97 of /app/frontend/app/admin/question-form.tsx)

issues: Submit button only appears on last question which is correct, but after a non-last-question submit via close-btn, confirm modal works fine. UI is clean.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely from a third-party component or inline usage. Low priority but should be migrated. Reference: console log on initial app load.

action_items: Investigate and fix 'Unexpected text node' warning on /app/frontend/app/admin/question-form.tsx — likely a stray space/newline inside a <View> or between JSX fragments.
Migrate deprecated props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents wherever used (search for pointerEvents=... in codebase).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single ~890-line file; consider splitting into routers (auth, catalog, tests, admin, seed) for maintainability but not blocking.

/api/tests/start accepts chapter mode with any number of chapter_ids; business rule says chapter=1 and mixed=exactly 4 chapters, but enforcement is only on the frontend. Backend-side validation would be safer.
Guest start endpoint does not enforce question_count limits (clients could request very large counts). Consider capping on server.
seed_data_creation: Did not create new seed data. Used existing pre-seeded admin/student sessions and 34 sample questions (plus 1 TEST_ CSV-inserted question that was auto-cleaned via admin DELETE in test flow; one leftover TEST_ bulk-CSV question remained since bulk-csv test did not delete it — low priority, source='TEST').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_studyadda_api.py run with pytest; need EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env (defaults to preview URL). Test tokens Bearer test_admin_token_123 / test_student_token_123 are pre-seeded in MongoDB and valid 30 days. Frontend auth is done via localStorage: window.localStorage.setItem('sa_session_token', JSON.stringify('test_admin_token_123')) then reload. Mobile viewport 390x844.
rca_of_issue: The 'Unexpected text node' warning on the Add Question screen is a React Native web rendering issue — some text (perhaps a comma or whitespace from a conditional expression) is being rendered as a direct child of a <View>. Check lines 75-97 of /app/frontend/app/admin/question-form.tsx especially the fragment `<>...</>` wrapper and `{subjectId && (...)}` conditional returns. Non-blocking; functionality works.
